content.title: How to watch Cleveland Cavaliers vs. Atlanta Hawks on Rock Entertainment Sports Network
content.text: Skip to contentCLEVELAND, Ohio (WOIO) - The Cleveland Cavaliers are back on the Rock Entertainment Sports Network (RESN) on Wednesday night! RESN is available on Channel 22.1 with free over-the-air broadcasts.On Spectrum in Northeast Ohio, RESN is Channel 979.
